modelAtelier.reference: One continuous five-digit robotic humanoid. xatlas-relaxed and packed native UVs with separate real chart seams and reprojection of the existing satin / graphite / teal material PNG. No hat-style front/back/brim atlas. Original geometry proportions and face count remain unchanged. Not skinned.
